findings.text: non-blocking: the inside-is-None default scores psi_norm <= 1.0 only, while the docstring at nova/imas/edge_consistency.py:156 promises the plasma interior 0 <= psi_norm <= 1; a caller following the documented definition gets a whole-slice form that includes cells below the axis flux, so it no longer reads against the parity chain, which is fenced to interior in-limiter cells at nova/imas/mast_parity_chain.py:435. Measured inert on the analytic fixture - zero of 3969 finite cells carry psi_norm < 0 (minimum 1.58e-05 over 2402 scored cells) - so the divergence is latent, not live, and the one test that would catch it (tests/test_edge_consistency.py:152 applies its own >= 0.0 bound) agrees with the code today only because the fixture never exercises the difference.

non-blocking: structured_grid_current_density duplicates a capability the repository already owns at nova/equilibrium/map_extraction.py:132 (apply_delta_star), whose operator is nova/equilibrium/conservation.py:219 - same central-difference Delta*, same -Delta*Phi/(TOTAL_FLUX_FACTOR mu_0 R) recovery, same interior mask. Measured on the analytic flux the two agree to 4.0e-16 relative in double precision, so the addition duplicates rather than extends the owner and the repository now carries two implementations of one operator that can drift apart.

non-blocking: band_cell_count is compared between two runs of the same code path on the same grid, so both sides move together; the assertion cannot fail unless the measure is nondeterministic and does not show that the negative control left the band definition untouched.

non-blocking: the after_suite record's log_path names a directory rather than a log file, so a receipt reader that opens that path reads a listing instead of the suite's exit line; the individual logs are named under test_logs, but the machine-read field is unreadable as a log.

non-blocking: every head-arm gate log of the reviewed run opens with a revision header naming the base commit ("# revision: e69f4b60af04df8259ef914dee3136a3c55f6cb2 (base) + working tree") although the arm ran the worktree that was committed as 9b6422bb0, so a reader cannot tell the base arm from the head arm by the header alone; and logs/negative_control_band_ff_prime.txt:3 records "# command: (the declared mutation run)" instead of the command that ran, so the red log names a later reader no re-executable check. A coordinator's manifest check refuses a record that cites that log as its arm for exactly this reason, so the defect costs a promotion round-trip rather than only legibility.

item_verdicts.done_when: VERDICT done_when: the done_when names the analytic-state order fit, a 1 per cent FF-prime detection and the band-only negative control; tests/test_edge_consistency.py:199 fits the order over three resolutions and asserts 1.7 < order < 2.3, :168 asserts the perturbation clears the threshold, :179 is the control, and each result is recorded in the fragment and the logs.
item_verdicts.goal: VERDICT goal: the node's goal is an edge-consistency measure between an equilibrium's flux functions and its flux map, proved on the analytic state; nova/imas/edge_consistency.py:81-260 lands exactly that, with the three forms the brief names and EDGE_BAND_RELATIVE_THRESHOLD / EDGE_BAND_WIDTH as named constants stated beside their measured basis.
item_verdicts.manifest: VERDICT manifest: read; it states status complete, records the base and head arms as zero failures with their logs and the literal head command, and records the negative-control log that reddens on the band-only mutation.
item_verdicts.write_paths: VERDICT write_paths: the declared paths are nova/imas/ edge_consistency.py and mast_parity_chain.py, tests/test_edge_consistency.py, tests/test_parity_chain.py, docs/figures/dd-cocos-edge-consistency and the fragment; the seven files in the diff all sit inside them, and nova/imas/parity_tolerances.py is untouched.

justifications.evidence: The manifest's gate command ran six files at the head with EXIT=0 and identical counts at the base in scratch/base-arms.log, and the numbers land as a separate node on top of this one.
justifications.fit: nova/imas/edge_consistency.py:78 follows the surrounding frozen-dataclass and numpy idiom and introduces no forbidden name, though its docstring at :156 states a scored set the code at :166 does not apply.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/imas/edge_consistency.py:73 returns the whole-slice, band-absolute and band-relative forms the goal names, and the band forms carry their own denominator at :192 rather than the slice-wide one.
justifications.reuse: nova/imas/edge_consistency.py:88 re-implements the structured-grid current-density read that nova/equilibrium/map_extraction.py:132 already owns, agreeing with it to 4.0e-16 relative instead of extending it.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in the diff is inside the declared write paths, and the diff does not touch nova/equilibrium/convention.py or nova/imas/parity_tolerances.py, which the brief fenced off.
